name: Rating
summary: Chooses or shows a score out of a few stars (reviews, feedback). Hovering previews a value; pressing the chosen value again clears it; words per value say what each score means. Read-only shows any fraction, such as an average. Not for a precise number (use NumberField or Slider) or a yes/no question (use SegmentedControl or Switch).
a11y: Input: a `radiogroup` named by the label with one `radio` per step ("3 stars, Good"), one Tab stop on the chosen step (or the first). Read-only: `role="img"` named "Average rating: 4.3 of 5". Stars are filled, never coloured alone: the value is also written when `showValue`. Stars sit 4 px apart; each is a 24 px target at size normal and l (a written exception: below 44 px, never below the 24 px minimum); size s is display-only scale for read-only use.

keys.action: the next or previous step (chooses it, as radios do); Home / End: the lowest or highest
chooses the focused step, or clears it when it is already chosen and `clearable`

props.name: label
props.description: What is being rated, e.g. "Your rating" or "Average rating". Shown unless `hideLabel`; always the accessible name.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the visible label where a heading or row already says what is rated.

props.name: value
props.description: The rating, from 0 to `max`; null when nothing is chosen yet. Read-only ratings may be any fraction (4.3).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new rating, or null when the chosen value is pressed again to clear it.

props.name: precision
props.description: The smallest step a person can choose: whole stars or halves.

props.name: words
props.description: Words for each whole value, e.g. ["Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Very good", "Excellent"]; shown beside the stars and announced.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Writes the value beside the stars ("4.3 of 5", or the value's words).

props.name: clearable
props.description: Pressing the chosen value again clears the rating.

props.name: size
props.description: s 16 px stars for cards and tables, normal 24 px for forms, l 32 px for a page's main question.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the rating without input: an average or someone else's rating.
